family_definition.inclusion_rule: A Government Resolution adopted under Federal Law 187-FZ article 6 that expressly approves sector-specific features for categorization of Russian CII objects.
family_definition.scope_claim: All seven Government resolutions returned by three independent official-publication title searches through the as-of date are indexed and have preserved primary PDFs and clause maps.
family_definition.guardrail: Exhaustiveness is limited to the officially published Government-resolution set matching the recorded query family through 2026-08-19. It does not prove that no signed but unpublished act exists and does not resolve the transport project as an adopted act.

dependency_edges.temporal_guard: PP RF 402 is not in force until 2026-09-01; operational treatment before that date requires legal review and must not be inferred from this graph.
